exposure: Maternal characteristics (gestational age, parity, BMI, smoking, hypertension)
outcome: Maternal arterial blood gas parameters (pH, pCO2, pO2, sO2)
cohort: 250 women undergoing vaginal delivery and 58 women undergoing planned cesarean section
finding: Maternal arterial blood gas parameters varied significantly according to mode of delivery, the use of epidural anesthesia, and synthetic oxytocin.
mod_finding: Maternal arterial blood gas parameters, including pH, pCO2, and lactate, were significantly different between vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
